part: Upper bulkhead (gear box upper half) of the Carten T410R, new design, model version 1
coordinate_system: Same as the lower bulkhead: origin at the centre of the 4 bottom holes of the lower part on its bottom face, x along the diff axis, +y toward the pinion and the centre shaft, +z up. The upper part sits on the parting face (z = axis_z of the lower part). Heights named h_... are measured from the parting face.
shared_parameters: cad/bulkhead/bulkhead_lower_v2_parameters.json: parting face height, diff axis, bearing seats and lips, gear cavities, pinion seat, positions and sizes of the 4 screw bosses of the lower part.
design: Prismatic part: the footprint of the lower part, extruded to 4 flat levels along y (flange, gear block, shock tower wall, top brace face). All outer faces are flat; the only curved faces are the bores and the cavities, which follow the lower part.

source_codes.user: Information from the owner of the car
source_codes.brace: Geometry data of the top brace v2 (cad/chassis_v2/top_brace/top_brace_v2_geometry.json)
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the stock upper part (second set, rulers in the views), accuracy approx. +-1.5 mm. To be replaced by caliper values (measurement sheet of the upper part).
source_codes.design: Design choice of the new part, free

outer_end_y.note: Outer end of the upper part. The stock upper part ends approx. 4.2 mm beyond the outer screw holes, so that the sway bar holders (M3x6 from above onto the tabs of the lower part, manual step 23) have room.

corner_r.note: Corner radius of the footprint (top view).

cover_wall.note: Wall thickness in front of the ring gear cavity (radius 16.4 of the lower part). Sets the front face of the gear block: diff axis - 16.4 - 2.0 = -17.9.

gear_block_h.note: Top of the gear block above the parting face: ring gear cavity 16.4 + 1.6. Not higher than tower_keepout_h, so that the shock tower plate has room in front of the wall.

deck_h.note: Top brace contact face above the parting face (flat face from deck_end_y - 0.5 to the pinion end). Stock part: top of the 2 raised bosses, end and side views 15.0 to 17.3.

deck_end_y.note: End of the top brace above the bulkhead: deck screw y minus 3.35 (B01 to the end of the top brace). The gear block ends 0.5 before it.

deck_screw_x.note: Position of the 2 top brace screws in x (+-). Top view photo: spacing 25.4 to 25.7. Top brace: B01/B02 26.1, B14/B15 25.66.

deck_screw_y.note: Position of the 2 top brace screws in y: pinion side screws (21.3) minus 6.94 (spacing B01 to B03 of the top brace). Top view photo: 7.0.

deck_hole_depth.note: Drill depth. Screws M3x8 (manual step 25) through the 2 mm top brace: 6 mm thread engagement.

pinion_end_r.note: Radius of the half cylinder over the outer pinion bearing beyond the end of the footprint (same as the pinion housing of the lower part).

boss_recess_clearance.note: Diametral clearance of the 4 recesses on the underside for the bosses of the lower part (boss 4.86, recess 5.06).

boss_recess_extra_depth.note: Recess depth = boss height above the parting face (2.42) + 0.1.

screw_hole_d.note: Clearance hole of the 4 M3 screws to the lower part.

counterbore_d.note: Counterbore for the heads of the pinion side screws (button head 5.7) from the top brace face down to the head seat.

screw_len_outer.note: Button head screws M3x8 on the outer side. The heads sit on the flange.

screw_len_pinion.note: Button head screws M3x10 on the pinion side. The top brace has access holes above them (B03/B04 and B12/B13).

thread_engagement.note: Thread engagement of the 4 screws in the bosses of the lower part (1.8 x d). Sets the head seats: h = boss height 2.42 + screw length - 5.5, outer side 4.92 (= flange thickness), pinion side 6.92.

tower_face_y.note: Contact face of the shock tower (faces the outer side). Side views: 5.1 to 6.7 mm from the diff axis toward the outer side.

tower_hole_x.note: Position of the 4 shock tower holes in x (+-). End views: spacing approx. 20 mm.

tower_hole_h_lower.note: Height of the 2 lower shock tower holes above the parting face.

tower_hole_h_upper.note: Height of the 2 upper shock tower holes above the parting face.

tower_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3, through the wall.

tower_plate_t.note: Thickness of the carbon shock towers (spec_cartent410r.yaml).

tower_screw_len.note: 4 button head screws M3x8 per shock tower (steps 19 and 20). Thread engagement in the wall: 5.0.

tower_keepout_h.note: In front of the contact face, the zone above this height is kept free for the shock tower plate (lower holes minus 4.7).

wall_t.note: Thickness of the shock tower wall in y. Full width of the part.

wall_top_h.note: Top of the shock tower wall above the parting face (top of the stock ears).

print_seat_allowance.note: Test print only: added to the bearing seat diameters.

print_tap_d.note: Test print only: diameter of the tapped holes for self-tapping screws.
